name: aider_replica
description: Source-aligned Aider architect/editor loop: explicit plan approval, deterministic SEARCH/REPLACE parsing, recoverable partial edits, lint/test review and at most three reflection rounds.

architect.description: Produces the architecture proposal without editing

reviewer.description: Runs the automatic lint/test review without editing

judge_review.description: Convert lint/test observations into Aider's next reflection decision

inputs.instructions:
Answer the user's request without modifying the workspace. Ground repository-specific claims in evidence: use read_file or search_files whenever the workspace preview is insufficient. Never propose SEARCH/REPLACE blocks and never claim a file was inspected unless you actually read or searched it. Give a concise, direct final answer in the user's language.

Request: ${ctx.request}

approve.prompt_text:
允许按以下架构方案编辑文件吗？
${ctx.edit_plan}

approve_shell_commands.name: suggested_shell_commands
approve_shell_commands.prompt_text:
Aider 建议运行以下命令。是否明确允许审查 Agent 运行？
${ctx.suggested_shell_commands}

approve_reflection.name: aider_reflection
approve_reflection.prompt_text:
自动 lint/test 发现问题。是否让 Aider 再尝试修复？
${ctx.review_feedback}

value.message: Validation failed and the user declined another repair attempt.
Aider stopped after three unsuccessful edit/review reflections.

cancelled.value: 编辑已取消；架构方案保留在本次运行结果中。
